gate.name: git-diff-check
gate.required_fix_hint: Run `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` locally and fix the whitespace/conflict marker issues it reports in the PR diff.

gate.name: doc-contract
cmd:
import sys, os
_wt = os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1])
_cwd = os.path.realpath(os.getcwd())
_trusted = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ''
sys.path[:] = [
    _p for _p in sys.path
    if _p
    and os.path.realpath(_p) != _wt
    and not os.path.realpath(_p).startswith(_wt + os.sep)
    and os.path.realpath(_p) != _cwd
]
if _trusted and os.path.isdir(_trusted):
    sys.path.insert(0, _trusted)
from pdd.checkup_gates import run_doc_contract_check
sys.exit(run_doc_contract_check(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None))
gate.required_fix_hint: Verify that all added user-facing surfaces (CLI options, skip behaviors, environment variables, and .pddrc keys) are fully documented.
